Summary of websites shared in #general:

1. www.informations.com (shared by Bob): An article covering the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com (shared by Eve): Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for its authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. The restaurant offers warm wooden interiors adorned with Swiss memorabilia, stunning panoramic views of the city skyline, and friendly staff dressed in traditional Swiss attire — making every visit feel like a delightful journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you have a personal blog and that hiking is your favorite hobby — that's a great theme to build content around! I'd suggest adding more details, like your favorite hiking trails, photos from your adventures, or tips for fellow hikers. It would make your blog more engaging and give visitors more to explore. Keep up the great work!

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback. It's great that you have a personal website! Right now it's quite minimal, so I'd suggest adding more content about yourself — for example, your background, interests, projects, or skills. Including a short bio, some photos, and maybe links to your social profiles would make it more engaging and give visitors a better sense of who you are. Keep building on it — it has good potential!
